groups.context: Review the whole conversation around the invitation to keep talking despite disbelief.

records.Japanese:
FI！
あの船の旗！
records.current_English: FI! Look at that ship's flag!

records.Japanese:
あの『グラスにドクロ』の旗…
あれはイギリス王室の海賊…
クリフォードの船…
records.current_English:
That flag with a skull in a
 goblet... That's Clifford's ship.
 He's the English Crown's pirate...

records.Japanese: 間違いねえ、『ギャラハット号』だ！
records.current_English: No mistake--the Galahad!

records.Japanese: 『ギャラハット』？　うまいの？
records.current_English: Galahad? Does it taste good?

records.Japanese: バカ！　食いもんじゃねえ！
records.current_English: You idiot! It's not food!

records.Japanese:
提督、早くこの街を出ましょう！
関わると、ろくなことがありやせんぜ！
records.current_English:
Admiral, let's get out of this 
 town! Nothing good will come 
 of getting mixed up with him!

records.Japanese:
やばいよ、FI！
早くこの街を出なきゃ
ヤツは、相当な悪人だっていうし…
records.current_English:
This is bad, FI!
 We need to get out of town.
 They say he's vicious...

records.Japanese:
クリフォードってのは、そんなに
ひどいヤツなのかい？
records.current_English:
Is this Clifford fellow really 
 that bad?

records.Japanese:
あんた、この街は初めてなのね？
ジェームズ・クリフォードってのは
泣く子も黙る鬼海賊って噂よ
records.current_English:
Your first time here, right? 
 They say James Clifford's a pirate 
 so fearsome even crying children 
 go quiet at his name.

records.Japanese:
何でも、雲を突くような巨漢で
目が３つあって、口は耳まで裂けてて
人の生き血をグラスに注いで
飲むらしいわ
records.current_English:
They say he's a towering giant 
 with three eyes and a mouth that 
 stretches from ear to ear. He
 drinks human blood from a goblet!

records.Japanese: おいおい、それは人間かい？
records.current_English: Come on, is that even a human being?

records.Japanese:
だってだって、たった１人で１つの
艦隊を全滅させちゃうのよ
絶対、化物よ！
records.current_English:
But he wiped out an entire fleet 
 all by himself! He has to be 
 a monster!

records.Japanese:
俺が化物か…
ははは、こいつは参ったな
records.current_English:
Me, a monster...? Ha ha ha! Well,
 that's a new one.

records.Japanese:
でしょ？　ホント参っちゃうわ
…？
records.current_English: Exactly! What a nightmare. ...Wait.

records.Japanese:
俺って…。まさか、あんたが？
ク、クリフォード？？
records.current_English:
Me...? Wait, are you...? 
 C-Clifford?!

records.Japanese: なにー！　この優男がクリフォード！？
records.current_English: What?! This pretty boy is Clifford?!

records.Japanese: なんと、この男がクリフォードだと！
records.current_English: What? This man is Clifford?!

records.Japanese:
まあ、そんなとこかな…
化物はひどいねえ…
records.current_English:
More or less... Though calling me
 a monster seems a little harsh.

records.Japanese:
ま、まずいよ
FI…
早く謝りなよ
records.current_English:
Th-this is bad, FI... Apologize 
 to him, quick!

records.Japanese:
ご、ごめんなさい…
まさかあのクリフォードが
こんな普通の人だなんて……あっ！
records.current_English:
I-I'm sorry... I never thought 
 the famous Clifford would look so
 ordinary... Oh!

records.Japanese: FIっ！
records.current_English: FI!

records.Japanese:
いいよ、いいよ。気にしちゃいない
それより君
FI・FAだね？
records.current_English:
No harm done. Now, you're
 FI FA?

records.Japanese: 知ってるの、あたしたちのこと？
records.current_English: You know about us?

records.Japanese:
まあな。この仕事やってると
いろんな情報が入ってくる
records.current_English:
Well, yes. You hear all sorts
 of things in my line of work.

records.Japanese:
まさか、FOに
手を出す気…？
records.current_English:
You're not planning to go after
 FO, are you...?

records.Japanese:
おいおい、俺が何でもかんでも
潰すというのは単なる噂だよ
records.current_English:
Come now. The idea that I crush
 anything and everything is 
 just a rumor.

records.Japanese: そうかしら……？
records.current_English: Really...?

records.Japanese:
まあ、信じるも信じないも
君の勝手だ
ともかく、君と話をしたい
records.current_English:
Believe me or not, 
 that's up to you. Either way,
 I'd like to talk to you.

records.Japanese: 話って？
records.current_English: Talk about what?

records.Japanese:
…ここじゃ、ちょっとな
今夜、俺の家に来てほしい
夕食を共にしながら話したい
records.current_English:
I'd rather not discuss it here...
 Come to my home tonight. I'd like
 us to talk over dinner.

records.Japanese: んん？　いま、ごはんって言った！？
records.current_English: Huh? Did you say dinner?!

records.Japanese:
ああ
客人としておもてなししよう
records.current_English:
Yes. I'll see that you're well 
 looked after as my guests.

records.Japanese: うん。分かった
records.current_English: All right.

records.Japanese: では、今夜。待ってるぞ
records.current_English:
Tonight, then. I'll be 
 expecting you.

records.Japanese:
…カミル、聞いた？　ディナーよ！
王国直属の海賊なら、きっと大邸宅
よねっ！
う～ん、わくわくしちゃう！
records.current_English:
Camille, did you hear? Dinner! 
 A pirate who works for the Crown 
 must have a huge mansion! Ooh, 
 I can't wait!

records.Japanese:
おいらも、わくわくだよ！
早く行きたいな～
records.current_English:
I can't wait either! Let's hurry 
 up and go!

records.Japanese:
ちょっと…。もしかして
その格好で出かけるつもり？
records.current_English:
Wait... Are you going dressed
 like that?

records.Japanese: えっ？　これじゃ変…？
records.current_English: Huh? Do I look that odd?

records.Japanese:
…あのねえ
あの人は海賊とはいえ、英国直属なの
つまり、貴族なんだよ
records.current_English:
Listen... He may be a pirate,
 but he serves the English Crown. 
 In other words, he's a nobleman.

records.Japanese: うん。そうなんじゃない？
records.current_English: Well, yes. I suppose so.

records.Japanese:
貴族のお宅に伺うんだから
海に出るのと同じ格好はないと
思うんだけど
records.current_English:
We're visiting a nobleman's home.
 I don't think you should wear
 the same clothes you wear at sea.

records.Japanese:
そっか…。そりゃそうよねえ
どうしよう？
records.current_English:
Oh... You're right. What 
 should we do?

records.Japanese:
うーん…。とにかく、ドレスを
手配しなきゃ。急いで作ってくれるよう
仕立屋に頼んでみよう
records.current_English:
Hmm... First, we need to find
 you a dress. Let's ask a tailor
 to make one in a hurry.

records.Japanese: うん！
records.current_English: Okay!

records.Japanese: なんとか夜までに間に合ったね
records.current_English:
We managed to get it ready in time 
 for tonight.

records.Japanese: おいら、待ちくたびれたよお
records.current_English: Waiting took forever!

records.Japanese:
それにしても…
驚いたよ…
records.current_English: Still... I didn't expect this...

records.Japanese: へへ、どう？
records.current_English: Heh. Well?

records.Japanese: 『馬子にも衣装』ってやつだね
records.current_English: Amazing what a nice dress can do.

records.Japanese:
…
（バカ。カミル、言葉を選べ！）
records.current_English:
... (Idiot! Choose your words, 
 Camille!)

records.Japanese:
…カミルに聞いたあたしが
バカだったわ…
records.current_English: I was a fool to ask Camille...

records.Japanese: おお、来たか
records.current_English: Ah, you're here.

records.Japanese:
FI・FA
です。晩餐へのご招待
ありがとうございます
records.current_English:
I'm FI FA. Thank you 
 for inviting us to dinner.

records.Japanese:
ほう…、どこかのご令嬢かと思ったよ
似合うじゃないか
records.current_English:
My... I almost took you for a young
 lady from a fine family. That
 dress suits you.

records.Japanese:
うふふ。クリフォードさん
口がうまいんだから
records.current_English:
Hee hee. You're quite the charmer, 
 Clifford.

records.Japanese:
どっかの誰かさんも
見習ってほしいくらいだわ
records.current_English:
I wish a certain someone would take
 a lesson from you.

records.Japanese: さあ、入ってくれ
records.current_English: Come inside.

records.Japanese:
すごいご馳走！
数え切れないくらいのお料理…
records.current_English:
What a feast! There are more dishes
 than I can count...

records.Japanese: す、すげえ…
records.current_English: A-amazing...

records.Japanese:
見たことないものばかりだよ！　ホント
どれから食べていいのか
迷っちゃうな…
もぐもぐ……す、すごくおいしい！
records.current_English:
I've never seen any of this
 food before! I don't know what 
 to try first... Munch, munch...
 It's so good!

records.Japanese:
おいしいなあ！
どれもこれもおいしいよ！
records.current_English: Delicious! Every dish is wonderful!

records.Japanese:
エミリオ、ブタじゃねえんだから
ナイフとフォークぐらい使え！
records.current_English:
Emilio, you're not a pig! At least 
 use a knife and fork!

records.Japanese: ふむ、なかなか結構な味だ
records.current_English: Hm. Quite good.

records.Japanese:
ははは、喜んでくれてうれしいよ
遠慮なく食べてくれ
records.current_English:
Ha ha ha! I'm glad you're enjoying 
 it. Help yourselves.

records.Japanese: さて、話というのは…
records.current_English:
Now, about what I wanted 
 to discuss...

records.Japanese:
ちょっと待って
このドレス窮屈で…
records.current_English: Wait. This dress is too tight...

records.Japanese:
ああ、もう
FIったら…
records.current_English: Oh, honestly, FI...

records.Japanese:
ははは。ムリしないでいいよ
じゃあ、奧で着替えておいで
records.current_English:
Ha ha ha! There's no need
 to force yourself. Go and change 
 in the back.

records.Japanese:
ふう。やっぱりドレスより、こっちの
ほうが、あたしには合ってるなあ
…ごめんなさい、お待たせしちゃって
records.current_English:
Whew. These clothes suit me much 
 better than that dress. Sorry
 to keep you waiting.

records.Japanese: さてと。じゃあ本題に入ろうか
records.current_English: Now, down to business.

records.Japanese:
スペイン王国の海軍総司令に
ペドロ・バルデスという男が就任した
のは知っているか？　こいつがまた
歴代総司令でも一二を争う強者だ
records.current_English:
Did you hear? Pedro Valdes is now
 commander in chief of Spain's
 navy. He's one of the strongest
 commanders they've ever had.

records.Japanese: その話なら、私も聞いたことがある
records.current_English: That news reached me too.

records.Japanese:
スペインか…。あの無敵艦隊が
いま以上に強くなられちゃ
たまらないわよ
records.current_English:
Spain... The last thing we need
 is for that Armada to get even 
 stronger.

records.Japanese: そうだろう？　それは俺にも同じだ
records.current_English: Exactly. And the same goes for me.

records.Japanese:
えー？　ウソでしょ？
クリフォード軍は無敵で
スペイン海軍なんて眼中にないって
評判よ？
records.current_English:
What? You're kidding! They say your
 fleet's invincible and doesn't 
 even consider the Spanish navy 
 a threat!

records.Japanese:
いくらなんでも
あの男が相手となると…
records.current_English: Even so, with that man in command...

records.Japanese: そんなにすごい相手なんだ…
records.current_English: He's that formidable...?

records.Japanese:
そこで、君に相談だ
俺と手を組まないか？
records.current_English:
So here's my proposal. 
 Why don't you join forces with me?

records.Japanese: あたしたちと？　どういうこと？
records.current_English: With us? What do you mean?

records.Japanese:
俺たちが協力しあえば、奴らとて
そう簡単には手を出せまい
そうだろう？
records.current_English:
If we work together, even they 
 won't be so quick to move against
 us. Don't you agree?

records.Japanese: ふむ、悪い手ではないが…
records.current_English: Hmm. Not a bad idea, but...

records.Japanese:
…そうかもしれない
でも、スペイン海軍を倒すなんて
あたし…
records.current_English:
Maybe you're right. But taking 
 on the Spanish navy... I don't 
 think I...

records.Japanese:
おいおい。君たちにそんなことは
求めていないよ
records.current_English:
Come now. I'm not asking you 
 to do that.

records.Japanese: じゃあ、何よ？
records.current_English: Then what?

records.Japanese:
いいかい。君は俺と手を組んで
奴らの動きを牽制する
records.current_English:
Listen. You join forces with me, 
 and we keep their movements
 in check.

records.Japanese: それだけ？
records.current_English: That's all?

records.Japanese:
それで十分だ。なあ、世界は広いんだぜ
共同でヤツの勢力を押さえておいて
それぞれ、他の地域に勢力を
伸ばすんだよ
records.current_English:
That's enough. Look, it's a big
 world. Together, we keep his 
 forces in check while each of us 
 expands into other regions.

records.Japanese:
そっか！　北海じゃなくて、お互いが
アフリカやインドに向かうのね！
records.current_English:
Oh, I see! Instead of staying
 in the North Sea, we each head 
 for places like Africa and India!

records.Japanese: なるほどな…
records.current_English: Makes sense.

records.Japanese: そうだ
records.current_English: Right.

records.Japanese:
俺はイギリス本国の方針通りに
新大陸に向かい、君はオランダの
南下政策に従って、アフリカから
インド、アジアへと向かう
records.current_English:
I'll follow English policy 
 to the New World. You'll follow
 Dutch policy south, through Africa 
 to India and Asia.

records.Japanese: そうして力を蓄えれば…
records.current_English:
And once we've built up our
 strength...

records.Japanese:
…いつかは、あの無敵艦隊を倒せる日が
来るってことね！
records.current_English:
Someday we can defeat that 
 mighty Armada!

records.Japanese: そうだ。物分かりがいいな
records.current_English: Right. You learn fast.

records.Japanese: でも…
records.current_English: But...

records.Japanese: ん？　何か問題があるのか？
records.current_English: Hm? Is there a problem?

records.Japanese: あんたを信じていいのかどうか…
records.current_English: I don't know if I can trust you...

records.Japanese:
おやおや
これでも英国紳士だぜ
records.current_English:
Come now. I am an English
 gentleman, after all.

records.Japanese: そんなの関係ないわ
records.current_English: That doesn't prove a thing.

records.Japanese: 口では何とでも言えるからな…
records.current_English: Words alone prove nothing...

records.Japanese:
じゃあ、友好のしるしに
『紅色の顔料』をやってもいい
records.current_English:
Then how about the Red Dye 
 as a token of friendship?

records.Japanese: 顔料…？　何それ？
records.current_English: Dye...? What's that?

records.Japanese:
お宝が眠っている場所の地図を
解き明かす鍵なんだそうだ
…で、どうだ？　俺と組むか？
records.current_English:
They say it's the key
 to deciphering a map to hidden 
 treasure. So? Will you join
 forces with me?

records.Japanese: とりあえず、信じるしかないようだな…
records.current_English:
For now, it looks like we'll have
 to trust him...

records.Japanese: …ええ
records.current_English: ...All right.

records.Japanese:
そうこなくっちゃな！
よろしく頼むぜ！
records.current_English:
That's the spirit! Let's make
 this work!

records.Japanese:
新大陸には、あまり手を出さないで
ほしい。あそこに居座る連中は
俺の獲物なんだ
勝手にやり合ったりしないでくれよ
records.current_English:
I'd rather you didn't meddle 
 in the New World.
 The lot holed up there are my prey.
 Don't fight them on your own.

records.Japanese:
『紅色の顔料』は酒場の親父が
持っている
アムステルダムの酒場に行ってくれ
records.current_English:
The barkeep at the Amsterdam tavern
 has the Red Dye. Go see him.

records.Japanese:
分かったわ。言っとくけど
あたしを裏切ったら許さないからね！
records.current_English:
All right. But let me be clear:
 if you betray me, I'll never 
 forgive you!
